"""Independent v3 saved-array verifier; imports no project, geometry or simulator."""
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import gzip,hashlib,json,math,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
ROOT=Path('/Users/nilakarthikesan/.codex/worktrees/partner-simulation-review/grasp-failure-prediction')
BASE=ROOT/'research_artifacts/hug_full_field_mapping_repair_2026-10-15_v3'
OUT=BASE/'run_v1'
FREEZE='792b5768fc26e618c47c7dac7cb13b5830e88a63'
ACTIVE='acd393ead3430eca81eaf053ae0b852fa9ff8bf0182fe07cbcc5c0f9711c53be'
UNEXECUTED='dffea24a5fe3fe6c132339c4eb48899cee683f1fdc7f9a41785fdca14d8c7219'

def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(p):
 p=Path(p);return json.loads(gzip.decompress(p.read_bytes()) if p.suffix=='.gz' else p.read_bytes())
def arrays(p):
 with np.load(p,allow_pickle=False) as z:return {k:z[k].copy() for k in z.files}
def require(c,message):
 if not c:raise AssertionError(message)
def clas(d,r):
 require(d.ndim==2 and d.shape[1]==6 and r.shape==(len(d),),'field shape')
 require(np.isfinite(d).all() and np.isfinite(r).all() and np.all(d>=0) and np.all(r>=0),'finite/nonnegative fields')
 e=r[:,None,None]+1e-8;b=np.asarray([1,2,5])[None,None,:]/1000.
 lower=np.maximum(0.,d[:,:,None]-e);upper=d[:,:,None]+e
 near=upper<=b;far=lower>b
 return dict(near=near,far=far,ambiguous=~(near|far))
def fields(native,mapped,r):
 n,m=clas(native,r),clas(mapped,r);required=n['near']|n['far']
 preserved=(n['near']&m['near'])|(n['far']&m['far']);lost=n['near']&m['far'];added=n['far']&m['near']
 return dict(native_near=n['near'],native_far=n['far'],native_ambiguous=n['ambiguous'],required=required,preserved=preserved,
             definite_lost=lost,definite_added=added,unresolved_required=required&~preserved&~(lost|added))
def protection(a,b):
 lost=int((a['preserved']&~b['preserved']).sum())
 new=int(((b['definite_lost']|b['definite_added'])&~(a['definite_lost']|a['definite_added'])).sum())
 ori=bool(np.all(~a['orientation_valid']|b['orientation_valid']) and np.all(~a['orientation_passed']|b['orientation_passed']))
 return dict(passed=lost==0 and new==0 and ori,lost_baseline_passing=lost,new_definite_violations=new,orientation_protected=ori)
def counterexamples(a,b,c):
 lost=(a['preserved']|b['preserved'])&~c['preserved']
 definite=c['definite_lost']|c['definite_added']
 new=definite&(~(a['definite_lost']|a['definite_added'])|~(b['definite_lost']|b['definite_added']))
 return [list(map(int,row)) for row in np.argwhere(lost|new)]
def transition_counts(a,b):
 aa={'preserved':a['preserved'],'definite_failure':a['definite_lost']|a['definite_added'],'unresolved_required':a['unresolved_required']}
 bb={'preserved':b['preserved'],'definite_failure':b['definite_lost']|b['definite_added'],'unresolved_required':b['unresolved_required']}
 table={left:{right:int((av&bv).sum()) for right,bv in bb.items()} for left,av in aa.items()}
 require(sum(sum(row.values()) for row in table.values())==int(a['required'].sum()),'complete native-definite transition partition')
 return dict(unit='fixed original-grid cell by same anatomical part by band tuples; overlapping bands are not independent contacts',
  baseline_definite_failure_to_preserved=table['definite_failure']['preserved'],
  baseline_unresolved_required_to_preserved=table['unresolved_required']['preserved'],
  baseline_definite_failure_to_unresolved=table['definite_failure']['unresolved_required'],
  returned_new_definite_failure=int(((b['definite_lost']|b['definite_added'])&~(a['definite_lost']|a['definite_added'])).sum()),
  lost_baseline_preserved=int((a['preserved']&~b['preserved']).sum()),full_transition_table=table)
def rank(a):return [int((a['required']&~a['preserved']).sum()),int((a['definite_lost']|a['definite_added']).sum()),float(max(0.,-a['margin_m'][a['required']].min(initial=0.))/.001)]

def verify_bindings():
 require(subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(ROOT),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==FREEZE,'HEAD changed')
 require(sha(BASE/'protocol.json')==ACTIVE,'active protocol changed')

 p=read(BASE/'protocol.json');require(len(p['bindings'])==379,'binding count')
 for name,digest in p['bindings'].items():require(sha(name)==digest,'bound input/source changed '+name)
 for file in (BASE/'protocol.json',BASE/'run_repair.py',BASE/'exchange_core.py',BASE/'repair_case.py',BASE/'visual_transform_check.py'):
  blob=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(ROOT),'show',FREEZE+':'+str(file.relative_to(ROOT))])
  require(hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()==sha(file),'frozen Git blob mismatch '+str(file))

 require(started['protocol_sha256']==ACTIVE and started['freeze_commit']==FREEZE,'actual start used another protocol')
 require(started['budgets']==p['budgets'],'actual start quotas differ')

def array_hash(value):
 a=np.ascontiguousarray(value);h=hashlib.sha256();h.update(a.dtype.str.encode());h.update(str(a.shape).encode());h.update(a.tobytes());return h.hexdigest()
def scalar_product(a,b):
 return np.array([[math.fsum(float(row[k])*float(b[k,j]) for k in range(3)) for j in range(3)] for row in a])
def scalar_volume(triangles):
 def det(t):
  a,b,c=t
  return math.fsum((float(a[0])*float(b[1])*float(c[2]),float(a[1])*float(b[2])*float(c[0]),float(a[2])*float(b[0])*float(c[1]),
   -float(a[0])*float(b[2])*float(c[1]),-float(a[1])*float(b[0])*float(c[2]),-float(a[2])*float(b[1])*float(c[0])))
 return math.fsum(det(t) for t in triangles)/6.
def visual_readback(index,result,p):
 binding=result['final_readback']['source_receipt']['visual_transform_check']
 directory=OUT/str(index)/'visual_transform_check'
 require(Path(binding['path'])==directory/f'case_{index}_visual_transform.json','visual JSON path')
 require(sha(binding['path'])==binding['sha256'],'visual outer JSON hash')
 receipt=read(binding['path']);ref=receipt['operands_and_outputs']
 require(receipt['status']=='VERIFIED_ORIGINAL_VISUAL_TRANSFORM_ARITHMETIC' and receipt['case_index']==index,'visual complete/case')
 require(ref==binding['operands_and_outputs'] and sha(ref['path'])==ref['sha256'],'visual operands outer hash')
 require(Path(ref['path'])==directory/f'case_{index}_visual_transform.npz','visual NPZ path')
 z=arrays(ref['path']);require(set(z)==set(receipt['array_hashes']),'visual array inventory')
 for name,value in z.items():
  require(array_hash(value)==receipt['array_hashes'][name],'visual array hash '+name)
  require(np.isfinite(value).all(),'visual nonfinite '+name)
 require(np.array_equal(z['vertices'],z['raw_compiled_vertices'].astype(float)),'literal compiled vertex conversion')
 require(np.array_equal(z['faces'],z['raw_compiled_faces'].astype(int)),'literal compiled faces')
 first=scalar_product(z['vertices'],z['geom_rotation'].T)
 centered=first+z['geom_position']-z['object_position']
 second=scalar_product(centered,z['object_rotation'])
 independent={'first':first,'centered':centered,'object_vertices':second};diffs={}
 for stage,actual in independent.items():
  require(np.array_equal(actual,z['scalar_'+stage]),'full scalar replay changed '+stage)
  for method in ('matmul','einsum','scalar'):
   delta=float(np.max(np.abs(actual-z[method+'_'+stage]),initial=0.));require(delta<=1e-14,'visual arithmetic coordinate discrepancy')
   diffs[stage+'_vs_'+method]=delta
 triangles=second[z['faces']]
 delta=float(np.max(np.abs(triangles-z['original_triangles']),initial=0.));require(delta<=1e-14,'all original face coordinates')
 diffs['all_original_triangles']=delta
 volumes={method:scalar_volume(z[method+'_object_vertices'][z['faces']]) for method in ('matmul','einsum','scalar')}
 volumes['original_triangles']=scalar_volume(z['original_triangles'])
 original=receipt['original_signed_volume_m3']
 for name,volume in volumes.items():
  require(math.isfinite(volume) and volume!=0 and math.copysign(1.,volume)==math.copysign(1.,original),'visual volume sign')
  require(abs(volume-original)<=1e-14,'visual full volume discrepancy')
 require(receipt['original_output_retained'] and receipt['scientific_acceptance_allowance'] is False,'original arithmetic-only scope')
 require(receipt['additional_forward_calls']==receipt['additional_distance_calls']==0,'visual extra operations')
 for indexed in result['auxiliary_artifacts']:
  require(sha(indexed['path'])==indexed['sha256'] and Path(indexed['path']).stat().st_size==indexed['bytes'],'visual top index')
 require(result['fit']['auxiliary_artifacts']==result['auxiliary_artifacts'],'visual compact/top index differs')
 original_source=receipt['original_callable'];require(p['bindings'].get(original_source['source_path'])==original_source['source_sha256'],'original visual callable not source-bound')
 return dict(json_sha256=binding['sha256'],npz_sha256=ref['sha256'],arrays_rehashed=len(z),vertex_count=len(z['vertices']),face_count=len(z['faces']),
     scalar_coordinates_per_transform=int(first.size),all_face_coordinates_checked=int(triangles.size),coordinate_max_difference_m=max(diffs.values()),
     independent_signed_volumes_m3=volumes,maximum_volume_difference_m3=max(abs(v-original) for v in volumes.values()),same_nonzero_volume_sign=True,
     original_callable_warnings=receipt['original_callable_warnings'],matmul_replay_warnings=receipt['matmul_replay_warnings'],
     numerical_comparison_only=True,original_outputs_retained=True)
